fullPassage: Having been guided to a small desk surrounded by dividers, I sat. It was my first day. Everyone in the office seemed busy and no one even looked at me. It felt as if no one knew I was there. After a while, a woman came over and quietly placed a bouquet of flowers on my desk. Before I could say anything, she walked away. A moment later, she returned with a warm cup of tea. "Welcome aboard," she said with a kind smile. "I know first days can feel a little invisible, but trust me, you'll fit right in." She introduced herself as Sarah and began showing me around the office, introducing me to the rest of the team. One by one, my coworkers greeted me warmly, each offering a kind word or a small gesture of welcome. By lunchtime, what had started as an anxious morning had turned into something truly heartwarming. I no longer felt invisible — I felt accepted.

A moment later, she returned with a warm cup of tea. "Welcome aboard," she said with a kind smile. "I know first days can feel a little invisible, but trust me, <u>you'll fit right in</u>." She introduced herself as Sarah and began showing me around the office, introducing me to the rest of the team. One by one, my coworkers greeted me warmly, each offering a kind word or a small gesture of welcome. By lunchtime, what had started as an anxious morning had turned into something truly heartwarming. I no longer felt invisible — I felt accepted.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 you'll fit right in이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fit right in = 잘 어울리다, 자연스럽게 적응하다. Sarah가 첫날 불안해하는 화자에게 건넨 위로의 말.
det.analysis:
① 자연스럽게 어울려 적응 — fit right in의 관용적 의미와 정확히 일치 ←정답
② 규칙 학습은 fit in과 무관 ←오답
③ 물리적 크기가 맞다는 직역적 해석, 비유적 의미 아님 ←오답
④ 능력 과시는 문맥과 무관 ←오답
det.tip: fit right in은 '바로 잘 어울리다'는 관용 표현으로, 새 환경에 자연스럽게 녹아들 것이라는 위로.
